worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.summary: Makes the whole body's scales clang: a ring of sound bursts out from the user, hitting every foe in range for Special damage and knocking each away from the centre by its own data and weight. After the noise the user's Defense drops one stage (paid even on a miss). The echo form first lights a warning ring on the user, then rings a second time from wherever the body actually is, at the cost of one more Defense stage and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.use.0: One body-wide blast to open a circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.use.1: Area Special damage plus knock-back on close pursuers
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.use.2: Echo form to ring a second time and catch those who step out
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.descrip: Centred on the user, every foe within %2$s blocks takes one hit for about %1$s special damage, lighter the farther from the centre (about 65% at the outer edge); foes with no line of sight behind a wall are not reached.

Foes struck are pushed away from the centre by their own weight and data (about %1$s blocks at base; lighter and nearer foes fly farther, heavy ones barely move); after the blast the user loses %2$s Defense stage(s), whether or not anyone was hit.
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.echo.on: Echo form: after the main ring a warning ring lights on the user, then after %1$s a second ring sounds from the body's actual new position at %2$s of the radius, keeping %3$s power; it deals damage and knock-back again and costs one more Defense stage, so a foe inside both rings is hit twice.
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.echo.of: Single form: one clean blast that drops only the native one Defense stage and casts faster, but rings no second time.
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
From level %1$s the clang power rises to %2$s.
From level %1$s the clang power rises to %2$s and the ring radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.clangingscales.prefere: On: after the main ring, a second ring sounds at about 0.8x radius and 45% power to catch those who step out; costs one more Defense stage, wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off (single form): one clean blast that drops only the native one stage and casts faster.
The companion only considers Clanging Scales when a threat is within this distance; smaller means point-blank only, larger lets it chase in.

Sounds the clang only when at least this many visible hostile foes stand inside the real ring (checked against this individual's ringRadius, height band and line of sight; foes outside or behind a wall do not count). Larger for surrounded-only, 1 to ring any single foe.
